questions.content:
The annual company retreat will be held at the Seaside Resort from June 15-17. All employees are required to attend the orientation session on the first day at 9:00 AM. Lunch will be provided on all three days, and there will be team-building activities in the afternoons. Please confirm your attendance by May 30th.

What is the main purpose of this notice?

options.text: To announce a vacation policy change
To inform employees about a company retreat
To schedule a meeting with management

questions.explanation:
Đáp án: D. has been employed
Giải thích: Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động – diễn tả công việc kéo dài đến hiện tại.
Dịch: Ông Perez đã làm việc với vai trò kỹ sư công nghiệp tại Gaberly Logistics gần 20 năm.

questions.content:
The marketing team _______ a comprehensive strategy for the new product launch next month.

Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: "Has developed" (present perfect) is correct because the strategy was completed in the past but is relevant to the present situation of the upcoming product launch.

questions.content:
The CEO's _______ speech motivated the entire workforce and boosted company morale significantly.

Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
questions.explanation: "Inspiring" is the correct adjective form that describes the nature of the speech. It means the speech had the quality of motivating or encouraging others.

questions.content:
You will hear a phone conversation between a customer and a hotel receptionist.

Customer: "I'd like to make a reservation for two nights, starting tomorrow."
Receptionist: "I'm sorry, but we're fully booked for tomorrow. However, we have availability starting the day after tomorrow."
Customer: "That would work. How much would it be for two nights?"
Receptionist: "It's $120 per night for a standard room."

How much will the customer pay in total?
questions.explanation: The customer is staying for two nights at $120 per night, so the total cost is $120 × 2 = $240.

questions.content:
From: sarah.johnson@techcorp.com
To: all-staff@techcorp.com
Subject: New Security Policy

Effective immediately, all employees must use two-factor authentication when accessing company systems. Please update your passwords to meet the new requirements: minimum 12 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. IT support will be available all week to assist with the transition.

When does the new security policy take effect?

options.text: At the end of the month

questions.explanation: The email clearly states "Effective immediately," which means the new security policy starts right away.

questions.content:
The conference will be held _______ the Grand Hotel _______ downtown.

Choose the best prepositions to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: "At" is used for specific locations/buildings (the Grand Hotel), and "in" is used for areas or districts (downtown).

questions.content:
The company's quarterly _______ showed a 15% increase in revenue compared to the same period last year.

Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
questions.explanation: "Report" is the correct noun form. A "quarterly report" is a standard business document that shows financial performance.

questions.content:
Assembly Instructions for Office Chair Model X-200:
1. Attach the wheels to the base
2. Insert the gas cylinder into the base
3. Attach the seat to the mechanism
4. Connect the backrest to the seat
5. Adjust height and tilt as needed

What should you do first when assembling the chair?

options.text: Attach the wheels to the base

questions.explanation: According to the instructions, step 1 is "Attach the wheels to the base," which is what should be done first.

questions.content:
If the weather _______ nice tomorrow, we _______ have the meeting outdoors.

Choose the best options to complete the sentence.
questions.explanation: This is a first conditional sentence (real possibility). The structure is "If + present simple, will + base verb." "If the weather is nice, we will have..."

questions.content:
Please make sure to _______ all documents before the meeting starts. We'll need copies for everyone.

Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
questions.explanation: "Photocopy" means to make copies of documents, which fits the context of needing copies for everyone at the meeting.
